verdict.rationale: Workable documents a built-in "Workable Agent" that takes on delegated top-of-funnel recruiting work: sourcing, screening and qualifying candidates, then handing over an interview-ready shortlist. A separate feature lets users "use AI to find qualified candidates." The evidence is a single marketing description, and delegation is scoped to the hiring funnel rather than a general in-product assistant; the MCP server is an external integration and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts arbitrary tasks, detailed docs on how users delegate to and supervise the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The Workable Agent runs the top of the funnel - sourcing, screening and qualifying every candidate against the spec - and hands your team an interview-ready shortlist.
Search yourself or use AI to find qualified candidates that match your specific requirements.
